sentences.text: Lack of motivation is not a reason not to do it

sentences.text: The goal is to move forward, not to beat yourself up
Anything I desire to do, I have the potential to get good at

I am interested in… What is the process?
I have always dreamt about ___, is it possible to make it happen?
You can't do that to your dream
It's gonna happen in a way you could never have guessed
sentences.note: Yet keep taking steps forward, keep helping and serving.
